_about: proto-kitchen (Zafar's rapid prototype, 1 Nov): the baking station's own data (js/cook/stations/baking.js; the card is recipes.baking in data/cook.json, its rows filled from the plan picked here). Zafar's turn-by-turn design (prototype-notes-2026-11-01.md 'Baking'; cook-baking-eggs.md end note): Nani gives one instruction at a time, each tap tips the jar or bag a bit more. A step: id (the container), amt (little: one tap, it stops, 'that's good'; lot: tap until lotTaps, 'enough'; more: a little, tap, 'still a little more', tap, 'enough'; jug: tap until `units` quarter cups in the measuring jug, its lines at a quarter, half, full, one and a half and two and a half, no numbers), parts (the card row's words, through the language engine). `plans` by level (one picked at random); the decoys (how many other containers stand in the row) are the central rules' (data/rules.json levels.decoys: 1-4, a lookalike at L4; S18); bakeMs the oven's time; `palette` the art colours.

station.name: Baking
station.verb: Nani's turns: a little, a lot; then the oven
station.goal: Tap what Nani names and tip it in until she says enough. Then bake the naan.

phases.mix: Tap what Nani names. Each tap tips it a bit more.
phases.oven: Tap the oven to open it, then the naan. Take it out when it's ready.

palette._note: S18 (s18-g-baking): the wall, tiles, counter, jug, mound and oven are pictures now (scene, items); what is left is the bake ring, the steam and the drawn drops for the containers with no stream picture yet (salt, yoghurt, ghee)

mixBowl._note: S19 (s19-wave-e2): the side-on glass bowl (B1 #108, B1f #109, cut by build/tools/art/s19_cut.py) standing on the worktop, its foot just above the shelf band (foot: the band's top less 24 by default): empty, then the flour at a quarter, a half, three quarters as the flour goes in (flour: its id), the shaggy dough once anything wet is in (wet); the dough is the shaggy bowl too until a dough ball is drawn in this bowl (the mini run's B1-2 ball is a different bowl). Was proto/baking/bowl-f-*.

jug._at: the jug's base (origin bottom centre), level with the bowl's foot
jug._lineAt: key = quarter cups (1 = a quarter ... 10 = two and a half), value = the line's height as a fraction of the jug picture from its TOP; five evenly drawn lines, no numbers. The game reveals a full jug through a rising mask up to the line, never a proportional fill.
jug.replaces: the drawn jug and its drawn fill
jug._jugV4: S19 (s19-wave-e2): water is drawn in the new glass jug (B2 #83: its empty jug-0 and its full jug-4; emptyFor swaps the empty picture for that fill; lineAtFor: its lines, from the four water levels drawn on B2, read off the cut); milk, flour, yoghurt and sugar keep the old jug's pictures until the new jug has them. The jug stands on the worktop now (at: its base), never on the band.

tray._note: an empty steel tray; flagged by artcolour (warm steel reads tan, 19%): the pots and bowls share that warm steel

naan._note: on its tray, registered with the tray: in the oven by the ring's progress; the tray alone is items.tray
naan._v4: S19 (s19-wave-e2): the naan on its tray raw and baked, on the worktop left of the oven, above the band. s19-games-2 (11 Nov; ART-73, the k2 run's B3a and B3b): four stages, raw, part-baked, baked and overdone (naan-tray-*; the trays came about 90% of their panel, so drawn.w sets the size in code). In the oven it shows through the door's glass on the rack, raw, part-baked as its ring passes part, baked at the ring's green; left in the oven overMs (mechanic.overMs, else bakeMs) past it, overdone: a look, never a verdict (as the fried egg's)
naan._part: the ring's share at which the naan in the oven turns part-baked (it is baked at the ring's green, 0.8)

naanOut._note: taken out of the oven, alone
